name: markdown-rs
label: markdown-rs
stages: Native markdown::to_html_with_options: fresh Markdown parsing to events and compilation to owned HTML; normal full entity support; no intermediate MDAST serialization
boundary: Uses the stable release, not an alpha despite GitHub's release ordering. CommonMark and independently selected table/strikethrough/task constructs are measured. The public single-tilde switch is disabled to match Ferromark. MDX, math, footnotes, frontmatter, bare autolinks and tag filtering remain off. MDX parsing support is not presented as equivalent to full compilation.
